scope: T2/F13#5 source dependency audit and supplemental capture cases; no native run or acceptance claim

checks.observation: water_world.current_at samples the current field at the subject position and passes the shared restored flag. Cue reads this method; it does not read velocity or steering.

water_mounted_swim updates the local human swim mode to MOUNTED. Cue then anchors and samples at mount_body; diving and combat suppress the cue. Human gear and Ripplet resistance are applied downstream of the current query.

Tidewake profile overlays lighting/surfaces; it does not alter current geometry, vectors, world flags, aquatic state or the device-local preference. Cue uses an opaque UI background and shape/text independent of world illumination. Pixel contrast remains unjudged.

checks.requirement: Restored cue visibility at First Shore test stand
checks.kind: CPU arithmetic from authored current values; does not prove native field selection or visible pixels

checks.observation: Accessibility row is included in the explicit focus lane and writes through key_bindings.save. smoke_settings checks D-pad reach and A toggle plus file reload when candidate is enabled. The smoke has not run.

Production current-flow view changes foam density, opacity, chop, speed and brightness from water_currents_restored. Shared look does not repaint the sea on restoration, matching ART_DIRECTION. Native motion/judging remains open.

next_native_proof.out_argument: Append --out=<fresh-output-directory> to each case. Coordinator verifies staged HEAD equals source_sha before admission.
receipt_requirements: Exit 0 plus complete metadata, exact source SHA and image hashes.
candidate=true in every case; current_candidate=false only in first case; shore_ecology_candidate=false throughout.
